## Walkthrough This PR simplifies the error handling logic in the CVO deployment resource builder. A single-line conditional change in `lib/resourcebuilder/apps.go` replaces a non-NotFound error check with a direct nil error check, making the guard for internal load balancer URL substitution clearer without altering the actual behavior. ## Changes **Internal Load Balancer URL Substitution Guard** | Layer / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| | **Simplify internal load balancer URL substitution guard**
`lib/resourcebuilder/apps.go` | Conditional guard for internal load balancer URL substitution is changed from `if !errors.IsNotFound(err)` to `if err == nil`, unifying the path for URL parsing and host/port extraction to execute only when the infrastructure-config fetch succeeds. | ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~3 minutes --- > [!IMPORTANT] > ## Pre-merge checks failed > > Please resolve all errors before merging.
